standard_prerequisites.name: Omega-extension of a topped model into a model of WKL_0-star
standard_prerequisites.statement: The proof starts from a result of Fiori-Carones et al (their Lemma 3.2) that from the auxiliary set P one obtains a P-computable countable coded model of WKL_0-star containing the jump of Y, hence a set P_0 with P Turing above P_0 Turing above the jump of Y; the citation is carried in the proof and its entry is attached with this card.
standard_prerequisites.use: It supplies the intermediate set P_0 that the first application of the cohesive-set proposition needs.

standard_prerequisites.name: The three forcing propositions chained by the proof
standard_prerequisites.statement: The article proves that the COH forcing produces a cohesive set while preserving well-foundedness of a power of alpha and controlling P_0 relative to the jump; that the SEM forcing over that model produces a transitive subtournament with the same properties for one lower power; and that the SADS forcing produces a homogeneous set preserving well-foundedness of alpha itself; their statements are retained with this card at source lines 461-468, 760-767 and 1102-1109.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof applies the three propositions one after another to descend from well-foundedness of omega_4 to the fourth power of alpha down to alpha itself, and to obtain the homogeneity of the final set.

standard_prerequisites.name: Stable colourings, SEM instances and SADS instances
standard_prerequisites.statement: A colouring on the model is an instance of the cohesiveness principle, and its restriction to a cohesive set is stable; a stable colouring restricted further is an instance of the ascending-descending sequence principle on a transitive set; the article identifies these instances in the proof.
standard_prerequisites.use: These identifications are what allow the three propositions to be applied in sequence to the same colouring.

core_obligations: Apply the cited isomorphism result to obtain a P-computable countable coded model of WKL_0-star containing the jump of Y, hence a set P_0 with P Turing above P_0 Turing above the jump of Y (source line 1365).
Define the sequence of sets given by the colouring, one set per node, so that cohesiveness can be applied to it (source line 1366).

Apply the cohesive-set proposition to the model and to P_0 to obtain an M-infinite cohesive set G_0 with P_0 Turing above the jump of G_0 plus Y and with the model of G_0 satisfying collection and well-foundedness of the third power of alpha; note that the colouring restricted to G_0 is stable, hence an instance of the SEM principle (source line 1367).

Apply the SEM proposition inside the model of G_0 to obtain an M-infinite transitive set G_1 with P Turing above the jump of G_1 plus G_0 plus Y and with well-foundedness of the second power of alpha; note that the colouring restricted to G_1 is an instance of the ascending-descending sequence principle (source line 1368).

Apply the SADS proposition inside the model of G_0 plus G_1 to obtain an M-infinite homogeneous set G with P Turing above the jump of G plus G_1 plus G_0 plus Y and with well-foundedness of alpha itself, which gives the three asserted properties of the counted proposition (source line 1369).

proof_roadmap.step: Get the intermediate set P_0 and set up the sequence of sets induced by the colouring.
Apply the cohesive-set proposition and identify the restriction as a SEM instance.
Apply the SEM proposition and identify the further restriction as a SADS instance.
Apply the SADS proposition and read off the three properties of the counted statement.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Proposition prop:rt22-wf（源 1356-1363 行，证明 1364-1370 行）：证明 RT²₂ 的解可以在计算上高于 Y′ 的同时把 WF(ω₄^α) 降到 WF(α)。证明虽然只有七行，但关键操作不是例行核验：作者必须先用外部的 ω-扩张结果造出中间的 P_0（1365 行），再把同一个着色 f 依次识别为 COH、SEM、SADS 的实例——先是「限制到凝聚集上稳定」从而成为 SEM 实例，再「限制到传递集上」成为 SADS 实例（1367-1368 行）——然后逐级应用三条命题，把序数从 ω₄^α 依次降到 ω₃^α、ω₂^α 直到 α，并保持 P 计算上高于每一层的跳跃（1367-1369 行）。难点在于「同一对象在不同层被识别成不同原理的实例」与序数指数的逐级下落必须严丝合缝；原文位置在证明的 1365-1369 行。
